description: The living shore's review cameras (Run 2, the first recorded play's fix round, L1): the HUD's shoulder view (F2) on the 10x island garage's south shore, where the generator's coast is a straight line 15 m long. shore_along stands where the founder marked it (the jetty's gravel at (9.45, 0, -34.3)) looking west along the shore with the sea on the right; shore_beach stands on the jetty looking east down the beach. Pass the 10x island with -Room (a folder) and the -Only ids; the wash is held at shore_clock_s seconds of the shore's clock (looks without a living shore ignore it), so a before and an after show the same moment. The founder's morning (16 October, 08:30) for the two views along the shore, noon for the jetty's.

clock.note: The founder's own morning: 16 October, 08:30, as mark 2 was taken (08:31 on the HUD's clock). shore_beach is at noon the same day.

cameras.label: The shore from the jetty's gravel, looking along it
cameras.purpose: Mark 2's spot: the founder on the gravel at (9.45, 0, -34.3), the shoulder view looking west along the shore, the sea on the right. The coastline was a perfect line where the water met the land; now the wash climbs the sand and draws back, with a wet band and a little foam on its edge.

cameras.label: The same shore, the wash drawn back
cameras.purpose: The same view a few seconds later in the wash: the sea drawn back from the sand it wetted, a lace of foam on its edge.

cameras.label: Down the beach from the jetty
cameras.purpose: On the jetty (14.725, 0.03, -34.55) looking east down the beach: the straight shore that ran off to the far end, the sea on the right now washing in and drawing back along it.
